__doc__: Map gesture names (MediaPipe canned OR your own trained labels) to actions. Merged over the built-in defaults. Local actions: takeoff, land, halt (cancel whatever it's doing and hover in place), cycle_mode, speed_up, speed_down, spin360, return_home, estop, orbit (circle the operator; repeat to stop), fly_north/south/east/west. Set a value to null (or "none") to disable a gesture. Runtime actions may use mission:HOLD, mission:RETURN, mission:GOTO, mission:WATCH, mission:SEARCH, mission:TRACE, mission:FOLLOW, or mission:REGROUP. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
